revisions.title: A reported critic becomes a practical test
revisions.body: Crito's reported encounter with an unnamed courtroom critic turns philosophy into a public target: the critic calls it worthless, while Crito's account keeps the criticism at one remove. The frame then returns to Crito's sons, distinguishing the older Critobulus from the younger child and making the question of who needs a teacher concrete.
